edits.before:
[Generative video](/world-models/generative-video/) learns physics from pixels, and a plausible future can ignore the pending action. The 2026 world-model survey lists causal-conditioning gaps first among its open challenges and calls visual plausibility a weak proxy for control utility <Cite id="world-model-survey-2026" />. Generative simulation moves the model off that path: a solver executes the generated task, layout, mesh or reward, so a mug with the wrong friction still cannot fall upward.

ManiSkill3 simulates with rendering at up to 30,000+ FPS, 10 to 1000 times faster than other platforms <Cite id="maniskill3-2024" />. Genesis World, which began as the academic project Genesis in December 2024 and is now supported by Genesis AI, combines a unified multi-physics engine, a photo-realistic renderer and a cross-platform compiler behind a Python interface <Cite id="genesis-world-2026" />.

edits.before: The push figure separates three layers. Appearance renders the mug, as a reconstruction, texture or video frame might. A physics proxy adds collision geometry, mass and friction, and the simulator integrates the push, sliding the mug by $d = v^2/(2\mu g)$ every time. Cosmos-Transfer1 generates the first layer from segmentation, depth and edge inputs, with Sim2Real among its uses <Cite id="cosmos-transfer1-2025" />. This is the [taxonomy's](/world-models/taxonomy/) verdict on Gaussian Splatting twins in mechanical form: a real-time radiance-field renderer supplies layer one <Cite id="3dgs-2023" />. Generative video tries to learn layer three, and generative simulation borrows layers two and three from an engine.

pins.phrase: Two October 2026 papers measured WAM design choices directly. OpenWAM, from Heng Yu, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Ehsan Adeli and colleagues at Stanford, pretrains the Wan2.2-5B video model causally on more than 10,000 hours of robot video and attaches an action expert that can generate jointly, video first, action first or decoupled. V-JEPA uses no pixel reconstruction, negative examples, text or pretrained image encoder. Its VideoMix2M set holds about 2 million videos from HowTo100M, Kinetics-400/600/700 and Something-Something-v2, minus validation overlap. Frozen-backbone evaluation trains only an attentive pooling head and classifier, for Kinetics-400 appearance and Something-Something-v2 motion <Cite id="vjepa-2024" />.

edits.before: V-JEPA 2 first learns action-free representations by masked prediction on over 1 million hours of internet video plus images (VM22M). An appendix ablation lists 76.5 under a different protocol. A probe over the frozen encoder and predictor reaches 39.7% recall-at-5 on Epic-Kitchens-100 action anticipation, from 32 frames at 8 fps ending one second before the action .

edits.before: 1. Every currently usable interactive simulator is generative. Genie 3, Cosmos 3, Odyssey-2 and the Interactive World Simulator render pixels a user can inspect and steer . NVIDIA's DreamDojo runs at 10.81 FPS for teleoperation, policy evaluation and planning , and Dreamer 4's world model runs in real time on one GPU . No interactive, action-controllable JEPA environment has shipped. 2. Latent-only objectives are hard to validate. Without a decoder, a reader cannot see what the model believes. V-JEPA prevents collapse with an EMA target encoder and stop-gradient, justified by an adaptation of BYOL's analysis and stated as a hypothesis . LeWorldModel trains end-to-end from raw pixels with two loss terms and detects physically implausible events by surprise . Klindt and colleagues prove that LeJEPA linearly recovers a world's latent variables under stated assumptions . In complex scenes, most models still score at chance on IntPhys 2 while humans are near perfect .
